examples.arabic: اخوتي هم مدرسون مجتهدون في العمل
examples.english: My brothers are hardworking teachers at work
examples.transliteration: Ikhwati hum mudarrisoon mujtahidoon fi alamal

examples.arabic: العمل كثير ولكن العائلة سعيدة جدا
examples.english: The work is a lot but the family is very happy
examples.transliteration: Al amal kathir wa lakin al aila saida jiddan

examples.arabic: ياكل الجميع بدون قيود وينسون قواعد العمل الصارمة
examples.english: Everyone eats without restrictions and they forget the strict rules of work.
examples.transliteration: Yaakulu al jami bidun quyud wa yansawna qawaid al amal as sarima

examples.arabic: بالتأكيد، فوجود الانسجام بين العمل والحياة الشخصية أمر ضروري، أليس كذلك؟
examples.english: Absolutely, for the existence of harmony between work and personal life is a necessary matter, is it not?
examples.transliteration: Bit-ta'keed, fa-wujood al-insijam bayna al-'amal wa al-hayah ash-shakhsiyyah amr darooree, alaysa kadhalik?
examples.storyTitle: An Appointment on Al Mutanabbi Street

examples.arabic: بالتأكيد يا آمنة، إذ يبدو أن العمل قد استنزف طاقتك بينما كنت أنا أكتب مقالي الصحفي؛ فما رأيك في طلب وجبتي شاورما بسعر مائة وخمسين جنيهاً مصرياً؟
examples.english: Certainly Amna, as it seems that work has drained your energy while I was writing my journalistic article; so what do you think about ordering two shawarma meals at the price of one hundred and fifty Egyptian pounds?
examples.transliteration: Bi-t-ta'kid ya Amina, idh yabdu anna al-'amal qad istanzafa taqatak baynama kuntu ana aktubu maqali as-suhufi; fama ra'yuk fi talab wajbatay shawarma bisi'r mi'a wa khamsin junayhan misriyyan?
examples.storyTitle: A Rainy Day and Changed Plans

examples.english: He chose a blue shirt for work.
